data.professional_title: AI-Powered Business Analyst | QA Test Lead | Payments & BFSI
data.summary: AI-Powered Business Analyst with 11+ years of experience in Payments and BFSI transformation. specializing in ISO20022, SWIFT MT/MX, CBPR+, cross-border payments, requirement elicitation, BRD/FSD authoring, stakeholder management, and end- to-end delivery. Strong exposure to real-time and cross-border payment initiatives, gap analysis, process mapping, data mapping, UAT/SIT support, and regulatory change implementation. Experienced in Agile and Waterfall delivery, with hands-on use of Jira, Confluence, SQL, Excel, Power BI, TOSCA, Postman, and Selenium. Completed a Master's Program in AI-Powered Business Analysis from Simplilearn in collaboration with IBM, gaining hands-on experience in AI-assisted analytics, Power BI, and agile delivery. CBPA-certified with a track record of bridging business and technology across HSBC, CIBC, Standard Chartered, and Citi.

responsibilities: requirements definition, solution design, and stakeholder alignment.
with BAs, SAs, PMs, and IT teams.
Led Business Analysis for ISO20022 MT-to-MX payment migration across the UK region, ensuring regulatory compliance across 10+ Lines of Business.
Led ISO20022 MT-to-MX migration and CBPR+ readiness across banking programs, aligning business requirements with regulatory and SWIFT standards.
Supported real-time and cross-border payment transformation initiatives with stakeholder workshops, impact assessments, and data mapping.
Partnered with business, technology, PMO, and testing teams to deliver BRD/FSD, UAT/SIT support, and smooth production transition.
Managed defect triage, daily governance calls, and cross-functional stakeholder alignment; delivered Hybrid Address implementation and ISO version upgrades.
Executed automated regression using TOSCA and Postman; supported UAT with scenario design, walkthroughs, and production validation.
Converted manual scenarios into Postman/TOSCA automation scripts; performed accessibility testing across 8+ applications; led SIT, E2E, and defect governance.
Conducted requirement gathering, workflow mapping, BRD/FSD authoring, and acceptance criteria definition across enterprise banking programs.
Supported real-time and cross-border payment transformation initiatives with stakeholder workshops, impact assessments, and data mapping.
Partnered with business, technology, PMO, and testing teams to deliver BRD/FSD, UAT/SIT support, and smooth production transition.
Performed Business Analysis for payments modules (ITT, ILT, INT, OTT, ONT, OLT); created process flows, data mappings, and user stories.
Led SWIFT STP engine validations achieving 100% STP compliance; supported multi-country UAT planning, execution, and reporting.
Executed SIT, E2E, and API testing for Citi's CDBE platform; built automated regression suites using Selenium and TOSCA;
performed production validation and requirement traceability.

standardization_metadata.duration_policy: Year precision: annual-resolution estimates from year-label differences, including current reference year for current roles; months are estimated years times 12, not known elapsed months. Year-label unions use common annual boundaries only for computation; no employment month is inferred. Month precision: elapsed calendar months (approximate). Day precision: completed calendar units. Aggregate unions use first-of-month boundaries for month-only dates; residual days use 365.2425/12 days per month, rounded to one decimal year.
